options.outgoingScript: function mapFromDittoProtocolMsg(namespace, name, group, channel, criterion, action, path, dittoHeaders, value, status, extra) { if (!path || !path.includes('desiredProperties')) { return null; } var statusCode = status || 200; var payload = { success: statusCode < 400, status: statusCode, thingId: namespace + ':' + name, path: path, data: value }; if (statusCode >= 400) { payload.error = value; } return Ditto.buildExternalMsg({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, JSON.stringify(payload), null, 'application/json'); }
